name: Bali
tagline: Tropical Paradise Meets Affordable Retirement — Live the Dream in Bali, Indonesia
description: Bali combines spiritual tranquility, jaw-dropping natural beauty, and a thriving international community at remarkably low costs. From the rice terraces of Ubud to the surf breaks of Canggu, Bali offers FIRE retirees a lifestyle centered on wellness, creativity, and outdoor living that feels like a permanent vacation.

quickFacts.visa: 30-day visa on arrival (extendable to 60 days); B211A social visa for 6-month stays; Second Home Visa (proof of funds ≈ IDR 2 billion, about $112K at current exchange rates); retirement visa (KITAS) for 55+ with $1,500/mo proof of income
quickFacts.internetSpeed: 30–100 Mbps (varies by area; best in Canggu and Seminyak)
quickFacts.safetyRating: Very Safe — low crime; main risks are motorbike accidents and petty theft
quickFacts.nearestAirport: Ngurah Rai International Airport (DPS) — direct flights to Singapore, Kuala Lumpur, Sydney, Tokyo
quickFacts.climate: Tropical with dry season (Apr–Oct) and wet season (Nov–Mar)

housing.description: Modest private 1-bedroom villa or apartment with garden in a quieter enclave (Sanur, Ubud outskirts)

dining.description: Warungs daily — nasi goreng, mie ayam, fresh juices — plus the occasional café

healthcare.description: Individual regional/international plan (~50yo); local care limited, evacuation to Singapore/Bangkok

entertainment.description: Yoga, beach days, temple ceremonies, rice-terrace walks, live music

1M.lifestyle: A modest private 1-bedroom villa or apartment with a garden in a quieter enclave like Sanur or the Ubud outskirts, and daily meals at warungs — nasi goreng, mie ayam, and fresh juices — with the occasional café. A rented scooter covers the island, and because local care is limited, a regional/international health plan with Singapore or Bangkok evacuation is essential even at this budget. Yoga, beaches, temple ceremonies, and rice-terrace walks are cheap or free. Comfortable day to day, though the expat-enclave rents and imported goods keep this above a purely local build.

housing.description: Charming 2-bedroom private villa with pool in Ubud, Canggu, or Sanur

dining.description: Mix of warungs and the thriving Canggu/Ubud café scene — avocado toast, organic bowls, and excellent Indonesian cuisine

healthcare.description: Comprehensive international health insurance with coverage at BIMC and Siloam hospitals

transportation.description: Scooter plus Grab car for longer trips; occasional driver hire for day trips

entertainment.description: Unlimited yoga studio membership, surf lessons, diving trips, weekend excursions to Nusa islands, live music

2M.lifestyle: A nicer 1-bedroom villa with a small pool in the Canggu/Sanur belt, dining across the warung and café scene several times a week, and a scooter plus Grab for longer runs. Comprehensive international cover, unlimited yoga, surf lessons, and weekend trips to the Nusa or Gili islands. Social, relaxed, and comfortable. (Interpolated tier.)

housing.description: Well-appointed 1-bedroom or small villa with private pool in the Canggu/Seminyak area

dining.description: Bali's strong warung-to-fine-dining spectrum, Locavore and the beach clubs included

transportation.description: Scooter plus a part-time private driver, domestic flights

entertainment.description: Beach clubs, yoga, diving, island getaways

3M.lifestyle: A well-appointed 1-bedroom or small villa with a private pool in the Canggu/Seminyak belt, with dining across Bali's strong warung-to-fine-dining spectrum — Locavore and the beach clubs included. A part-time private driver supplements the scooter, and domestic flights open up the wider archipelago. Mid international cover keeps Singapore and Bangkok specialists within reach. A genuinely affluent island life centred on wellness and the outdoors, tempered by patchy infrastructure at any budget.

housing.description: Architect-designed luxury compound with infinity pool, outdoor pavilion, and panoramic views in prime Uluwatu, Ubud ridge, or beachfront Seminyak

dining.description: Private chef preparing organic local and international cuisine daily; fine dining at top establishments for special occasions

healthcare.description: Top-tier global insurance; executive health checks in Singapore twice yearly; holistic wellness programs

transportation.description: Full-time private driver with luxury SUV; domestic flights; speedboat charters to neighboring islands

entertainment.description: Private surf coaching, exclusive wellness retreats, art studio space, regular trips to Komodo, Raja Ampat, and Lombok

domesticHelp.description: Full-time housekeeper, private chef, gardener, and pool maintenance staff

luxuryExtras.description: Balinese spa treatments weekly, custom surfboard shaping, private ceremonies with local priests, art collecting from Ubud galleries

5M.lifestyle: An architect-designed villa with an infinity pool in a prime Uluwatu or Seminyak spot, with a housekeeper and part-time cook, a full-time driver with an SUV, and premium global health cover with executive checks in Singapore. Private surf coaching, wellness retreats, and regular travel across the Indonesian islands. Daily life is very comfortable, with Bali's infrastructure limits the only real constraint. (Interpolated tier.)

housing.description: Large luxury villa with private pool and grounds in prime Uluwatu, Seminyak, or Canggu

dining.description: Fine dining routine (Locavore/Mozaic) plus a private chef sometimes

transportation.description: Full-time driver plus a scooter for quick trips

entertainment.description: Private surf, wellness retreats, island expeditions

domesticHelp.description: A housekeeper, cook, and gardener for the villa

luxuryExtras.description: Yacht charters through the archipelago, private wellness masters, art patronage

10M.lifestyle: A large luxury villa with a private pool and grounds in prime Uluwatu, Seminyak, or Canggu, staffed by a housekeeper, cook, and gardener — household help is inexpensive here. A full-time driver, comprehensive international evacuation cover, fine dining, and yacht charters through the archipelago. This is far more than Bali's market can absorb; the ceiling is set by the island's limited fine-dining depth, patchy roads and internet, and its distance from major hubs, not by the budget.
